name: Shinohara Mari
source:
Faction: Taimanin
Skill: End of the Earth (Endo Obu Aasu), Summer Maiden (Manatsu no Otome), Special Mission
Artist: [url=/s3450]Potion[/url]
Cards: [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/3d11697ac2f686369153be8626658d55.png]TM 4 Stars[/url], [url=http://taimaninarena.wiki.fc2.com/upload_dir/t/taimaninarena/232f4e769caebf212997e11824c2053d.png]TM 5 Stars[/url]
History:
Shinohara Mari is a student in Gosha Academy and works as an active Taimanin on missions.
Mari is described as an "eager beaver", working really hard and doing it with a bright attitude. Mari is humble about her accomplishments. She is also smart, not just in classes, but also in her work as a Taimanin. Despite her clumsiness that embarrasses her at times, she tries to better herself every day with a smile.
[From [url=https://breezewiki.com/taimanin/wiki/Shinohara_Mari]breezewiki.com[/url]]
